title: Research branches
what: A research branch opened from the web helper for an angle, run by the bmo research-branch command, and stopped as the record closes. Lives in src/web_helper/branch.rs.

title: Web helper
what: The shared helper holding one record's web reading: its research close, its session and Chrome, the roads a site tool reaches its site by, and the unread pages it writes. Lives in src/web_helper/ and tools/_shared/web.
